name: collabspace
description: Real-time multiplayer collaborative whiteboard with infinite Canvas, WebSocket streaming, and database persistence

scripts.dev: concurrently -n client,server -c indigo,green "npm run dev:client" "npm run dev:server"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=client && npm run build --workspace=server
scripts.start: concurrently -n client,server -c indigo,green "npm run dev:client" "npm run dev:server"
